name: Thor, God of Thunder
effect:
1 "Nordic" Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Must first be Synchro Summoned.
This card is always treated as an “Aesir” monster.
You can only Special Summon “Thor, God of Thunder” once per turn.
“Nordic Relic” cards you control are unaffected by your opponent’s card effects.
This card gains 500 ATK for each Equip Card equipped to it.
You can only use the following effect of “Thor, God of Thunder” once per turn:
● (Quick Effect): You can equip 1 “Nordic Relic” Equip Spell from your Deck, hand, or GY to this card.
